description: Fork of exp679 (1.6843 @ step 1800, 105M = exp670 + exp611-style read_out). Single change: v_lut from split-S=4 (n_heads=24, tph=128, n_outputs=16) -> exp611-style (n_heads=H=6, S=1, tph=512, n_outputs=64). v_lut per layer: 3.15M -> 12.58M (+9.43M, 4x). Total: 105.4M -> ~162M. Tests if v_lut benefits from no-S + 4x tph (exp611 style) when out_proj stays at exp670's nh=4 and read_out is the big exp611-style one. Note: in exp676 this v change hurt (small model + nh=4 out_proj failed to compose with no-S v); here we test if bigger read_out changes the picture. References: exp679 (in progress, ~1.7 trajectory), exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M, exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M (full exp611 with this v_lut + bigger qk + read_out), exp670 = 1.4569 @ 86.5M.
